description: Collapses repeated framing WITHIN a single message (never across messages — cross-message dedup is session_dedup's job, which is lossless by construction). Standard intensity. These rules target duplicated connective tissue, not duplicated facts.

rules.name: collapse_repeated_and_then
rules.description: "and then and then and then" → ", then". Repetition of a connective carries no extra sequence information.

rules.name: collapse_repeated_so
rules.description: Stacked discourse markers collapse to one.

rules.name: collapse_repeated_but
rules.description: Repeated contrast marker collapses to one.

rules.name: collapse_repeated_basically
rules.description: A repeated filler word is filler squared.

rules.name: collapse_duplicate_spaces_after_punct
rules.description: Whitespace normalisation after punctuation. NOTE: this is the only rule using a capture reference, and it re-emits exactly the punctuation it matched — no protected content can ride through it, because punctuation is never inside a protected span.

rules.name: collapse_trailing_politeness
rules.description: Repeated closing thanks collapse to one. Anchored at end-of-text so it can never eat sentence content.
